- Movement, jumping, punching, kicking, blocking, AI opponent
- Health, energy, timer, round, and victory systems
- Responsive desktop and mobile layout
- Animated city arena with neon signage
- Verified through desktop and gameplay screenshots

Run at **http://localhost:3002**.
